in_marathi.name: Maruti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Winds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maruti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maruti is a name derived from the Hindu god Hanuman, who is also known as Maruti. The name signifies the god as the lord of the winds, as he is believed to be the swift messenger of Lord Rama. Maruti is also considered the god of knowledge and wisdom.
